description: Generates an autonomous spray-drone flight plan (waypoints + timing) from a farm GeoPackage, accounting for nozzle swath, tank capacity, dispersion rate, and battery limits, via the generate-flight-plan Tapis app. Produces an updated GeoPackage (flight paths) and a flight_plan.json (waypoints/timing).

nozzle_swath_ft.description: How wide a strip of ground each spray pass covers, in feet. A wider swath means fewer passes to cover the same field, but less precise application.

flight_height_ft.description: Flight altitude above the crop canopy, in feet. Higher flights cover a wider effective swath but reduce spray precision and increase drift risk.

tank_capacity_gal.description: Onboard spray tank capacity, in gallons. Determines how much area the drone can cover before it must return to refill.

nozzle_flow_rate_gpm.description: Spray output rate per nozzle, in gallons per minute. Combined with dispersion rate, this sets how fast the drone can fly while still applying the target rate.

dispersion_rate_gpa.description: Target application rate, in gallons of spray per acre. A higher rate means slower flight (or more tank refills) to deliver enough product per unit area.

battery_time_min.description: Maximum flight time on a single battery charge, in minutes.

battery_reserve_pct.description: Battery reserve held back for a safe return-to-home, as a percent of total flight time.

home_lat.description: Latitude of the home/launch point the drone departs from and returns to.

home_lon.description: Longitude of the home/launch point the drone departs from and returns to.
